answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if its work is proven fake. A hollow profile with no stake history earns no trust and no paid tasks, while an attacker who spawns thousands of copies must fund every one, so the cost scales linearly with the attack. At the nadir of that cost curve, honest agents still profit from one real identity, but a Sybil farm faces ruinous collateral before it can harvest any nectar of rewards.
